routes.serves: note list JSON that feeds the home page notes area (pinned notes and regular notes)
create a note from the Take a note editor (title + content); returns 201 with the created note, 400 on invalid JSON body
update an existing note's labels (and title/content/color/reminder); returns 200 with the updated note, 404 when the note does not exist, 400 on invalid JSON body
soft-delete a note (moves it to the Trash); returns 200 with the note, 404 when missing
restore a deleted note from the Trash; returns 200 with the note, 404 when missing
archive or unarchive a note; returns 200 with the updated note, 404 when the note does not exist
pin or unpin a note; returns 200 with the updated note, 404 when the note does not exist
permanently delete a note from the Trash view; returns 200 with the note, 404 when missing
empty the trash; returns 200 with the removed count

notes: REQ-2.7.1 Assign label to a note: seed a regular (non-pinned, not archived) note titled 'Team retro add label' with labels:[] so it starts without the 'Work' label. The system contains the label 'Work' (label catalog: Work, Reminders, Work editable). Each non-trash note card already has a 'More options' button (REQ-2.3.1); its dropdown menu gains a 'Change labels' menuitem which opens the labels dialog: a floating panel listing every known label as a checkbox input (label text verbatim, e.g. 'Work'). Checking a checkbox assigns that label to the note (optimistic re-render + PATCH /api/notes/:id {labels:[...]} which already persists the labels array); unchecking removes it. The label chips are displayed on the note card ('Work' text visible on the card). The sidebar gains a label filter section: buttons named after each label (e.g. 'Work'); clicking one filters the notes grid to notes carrying that label (active state highlighted), and clicking the same label again or 'Notes' returns to the full list. This is the REQ-2.7.6-style filtered list behavior needed by the THEN clause (selecting 'Work' in the sidebar shows the note). REQ-2.7.2 (remove label) depends on REQ-2.7.1 and the same dialog, so the dialog supports unchecking from the start. Existing routes, pin/archive/delete flows and the home page layout stay unchanged; the PATCH labels handling already exists in backend/server.js.
